desc: Parse \(N\), \(K\), and the sequence \(A\) from standard input.
Implement efficient fixed-size combination enumeration with incremental XOR, using the smaller of selected and omitted sides.
Handle edge cases including \(K=1\), \(K=N\), \(N=1\), and duplicate values.
Validate the implementation against both samples and additional brute-force-checkable cases.
Print the maximum XOR value from a `solve()` entry point.
